def solve(case):
    payload = case["payload"]
    nodes_list = payload["nodes"]
    required_symbols = payload["required_symbols"]
    # Build node map
    node_map = {}
    for n in nodes_list:
        node_map[n["id"]] = n
    # Build children
    children = {nid: [] for nid in node_map}
    root_id = None
    for nid, node in node_map.items():
        if node["parent"] is None:
            root_id = nid
        else:
            children[node["parent"]].append(nid)
    # Map required symbols to bit indices
    sym_to_idx = {sym: i for i, sym in enumerate(required_symbols)}
    full_mask = (1 << len(required_symbols)) - 1
    
    # DP function
    from functools import lru_cache  # but careful: can't use non-standard? standard library
    # Use memoization dictionary
    memo = {}
    def dfs(nid):
        if nid in memo:
            return memo[nid]
        node = node_map[nid]
        # initial dp: only this node
        mask = 0
        if node["symbol"] in sym_to_idx:
            mask = 1 << sym_to_idx[node["symbol"]]
        dp = {mask: node["utility"]}
        # process children
        for child_id in children[nid]:
            child_dp = dfs(child_id)
            new_dp = {}
            # option to not include child
            for cur_mask, cur_cost in dp.items():
                # not take child: mask unchanged, cost unchanged
                key = cur_mask
                new_dp[key] = min(new_dp.get(key, float('inf')), cur_cost)
                # take child: combine with each child mask

                    new_cost = cur_cost + child_cost
                    new_key = new_mask
                    new_dp[new_key] = min(new_dp.get(new_key, float('inf')), new_cost)
            dp = new_dp
        memo[nid] = dp
        return dp
    
    root_dp = dfs(root_id)
    min_cost = root_dp.get(full_mask, None)
    return min_cost
